issues.quote: They are cheap and they go out when you are not looking
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the cigar going out or being relit, and it gives no duration for the time spent outside.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as a hint that Girard relit his cigar, which would suggest he stayed outside longer than the 10:21 to 10:46 window the watch readings describe.
